title: Coast Guard medevacs diver 65 miles west of Hudson, Fla.
description: An MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew from Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater, Fla., medevacs an injured male fisherman 65 miles west of Hudson, Fla., Friday, Sept 23, 2016. The man suffered an injury while fishing and was transported to Regional Medical Center Bayonet Point, Hudson, Fla., for urgent care. U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Clearwater.
